source_row.extraction_instructions: Single Hubble-CMS page of div.teaser cards (title link, one-line intro such as 'A two day in person event', start date + time). No pagination. Event pages give Date:/Location: lines and a 'More details'/'Book now' link; BAPM's own conference registers on a public CFS/EventsAir page whose fee list is parsed. Mixed BAPM and external events.

registry_comment: BAPM (perinatal medicine) meetings and events: teaser cards -> event pages; end date from Date line or intro duration; EventsAir fees for BAPM's own conference

concerns: Listing gives the START only; the end date comes from the detail header range, the 'Date:' line, or the card's 'two day' wording, in that order. Verified on Bayley4 (3-4 Nov), Neonatal Update (23-26 Nov), Spring Conference (9-10 Mar).

Most events are external (Imperial, Eventbrite, UCLH, Healthcare Conferences UK): booking is on those sites, stored as organiser_url (PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK in --coverage). Only the BAPM Spring Conference (public CFS/EventsAir registration page, second hop, 15 tiers incl. member early/late bird and virtual) and two pages that print fees (NeoFOCUS £250/day, Neonatal Palliative course '= £500 / £50') yield tiers. Members-only conference: the fee grid is published publicly and recorded as shown.
Hubble CMS listing shows all upcoming events in one page, no pagination; the 'BAPM Events' category is a subset of the same list.
Specialty is the family default 'Neonatology' (BAPM is perinatal medicine); the shared classifier has no neonatal rule.
Spring Conference abstract deadline (6 December 2026) is on the page but left to the merge-step classifier (harness --coverage prints SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE because it does not run the merge).
Towns outside the small UK dictionary (Salford, Prescot, Chertsey, Gateshead) get a city but no region.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges (end_date) checked against the page on every source; no fee-table images were seen on the tested pages; SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT warnings from the harness --coverage run were false positives (related-event lists / unrelated '4 days' wording on the same page).
remediator.audit not run (needs the database); harness --coverage was run instead.
Review fix: tiers whose label matches quiz/dinner/drinks/social/gala are dropped unless the amount is above 0 (removed 'Virtual · BAPM Pub Quiz' £0 from the Spring Conference).
